title: A tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude open-water search and rescue
abstract: arXiv:2611.22825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large aerial platforms often operate above 1.5 km to improve the efficiency of open water search and rescue (OW-SAR). However, long imaging distances, wide fields of view, and limited sensor resolution reduce objects to a few pixels, increasing their susceptibility to environmental interference and making detection harder than for conventional small objects. To our knowledge, existing datasets focus on low-altitude scenarios and do not support automatic detection at 1.5-2.0 km. We therefore present TinyWOD, a tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude OW-SAR using lifebuoys as detection targets. It comprises 11,359 manually annotated images and 19,505 annotated instances spanning diverse environments, lighting conditions, water colors, and surface ripples. Compared with existing datasets, TinyWOD contains much smaller objects and a substantially higher proportion of tiny instances; its average equivalent side length (ESL) is 12.7

translated_title: 面向高空开阔水域搜救的微小目标检测数据集
translated_abstract: 摘要：大型航空平台通常在1.5公里以上的高度运行，以提高开阔水域搜救（OW-SAR）的效率。然而，长成像距离、宽视场和有限的传感器分辨率会使目标缩小到仅有几个像素，使其更容易受到环境干扰，其检测难度远高于常规小目标。据我们所知，现有数据集均聚焦于低空场景，不支持1.5-2.0公里高度的自动检测。因此，我们提出了TinyWOD——一个以救生圈为检测目标的高空开阔水域搜救微小目标检测数据集。该数据集包含11,359张人工标注图像和19,505个标注实例，涵盖多样的环境、光照条件、水色和水面波纹。与现有数据集相比，TinyWOD包含的目标尺寸更小，微小实例的比例显著更高，其平均等效边长（ESL）为12.7（像素）。
tldr: 该论文提出了TinyWOD——首个面向1.5-2.0公里高空开阔水域搜救场景的微小目标检测数据集，包含11,359张人工标注图像和19,505个救生圈实例，填补了现有数据集无法支持高空远距离自动检测的空白。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TinyWOD, the first tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude (1.5-2.0 km) open-water search and rescue, comprising 11,359 manually annotated images and 19,505 lifebuoy instances with much smaller objects and a substantially higher proportion of tiny instances than existing datasets.
